recent_articles.title: Public outcry grows louder over power cuts in U.P.; Oppn. parties call it structural failure - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Kashmir MLA ‘boycotts’ L-G’s drug campaign after demolition drive in his constituency - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Anantapur police bust international cricket betting racket run from Philippines; 10 arrested - The Hindu
